start.text: Report sent. A job copied the customer table out, in small pieces, to a place nobody approved. Now the same thing can show up again, tonight.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Joshua, I read your report. Do not look at size tonight. The backup is the biggest thing we send, and it is fine.
A.name: Carla

B.text: Look at where each transfer goes, and how often.
B.name: Carla

C1.text: The [b][color=green]rulebook[/color][/b] lists the approved places for each computer. A backup goes to its own place at its own hour. A leak goes somewhere else, again and again.
C1.name: Carla

C2.text: No. The backup runs at night, and so do some updates. We block the wrong places, not the whole night.
C2.name: Carla

D.text: [b][color=red]Report[/color][/b] a transfer that breaks a rule. Let the rest [b][color=green]pass[/color][/b], even the big ones.
D.name: Carla

E.text: One transfer at a time. Big is not bad, and small is not safe.
E.name: Joshua
